structure.overview: The case concerns the appellant's appeal against the Refugee Protection Division's (RPD) decision excluding him from refugee protection under Article 1E of the Refugee Convention and section 111(1)(a) of IRPA, based on his status as an Italian permanent resident. The appellant argued errors in the exclusion analysis and sought to introduce new evidence, which the tribunal rejected. The tribunal upheld the RPD's findings that the appellant retained permanent resident status in Italy, was excluded from refugee protection, and dismissed the appeal.
